_about: Articles to turn into shorts, in order. When the list is used up, the newest guides without a short follow. Oct 2026: nationwide, seasonal 'Korea in <month>' and whole-trip itineraries do best (Korea in December 431 views, Korea 7 Day 281), so those come first. 26 Oct: month names beat season names (Korea in December 444 views, November 226, but 'Korea Autumn Leaves' 11), so month pages come before season pages and seasonal shorts are titled by month.
